kind: deterministic fixture for SpecForge offline mode
note: Synthetic completions only; no network call and no model was invoked.

listProducts.description: Returns a paginated page of products, optionally filtered by name or tags.

createProduct.description: Creates a product and returns the stored representation with a server-assigned id.

getProduct.description: Returns a single product by its identifier.

updateProduct.description: Applies a partial update to an existing product.

deleteProduct.description: Deletes a product; the response has no body.

listOrders.description: Returns a paginated page of orders, optionally filtered by status or customer_id.

createOrder.description: Creates an order for an existing customer and returns it with a server-assigned id.

getOrder.description: Returns a single order by its identifier.

updateOrder.description: Applies a partial update, for example a status transition, to an order.

deleteOrder.description: Deletes an order; the response has no body.

listCustomers.description: Returns a paginated page of customers, optionally filtered by email.

createCustomer.description: Creates a customer and returns the stored representation.

getCustomer.description: Returns a single customer by its identifier.

updateCustomer.description: Applies a partial update to an existing customer.

deleteCustomer.description: Deletes a customer; the response has no body.

ambiguities: The brief does not define currency semantics for price_cents/total_cents; the contract assumes minor units.
Order status transitions are not specified; the contract only enumerates allowed values.
Deletion semantics (hard vs soft delete) are unspecified; DELETE is modelled as hard delete returning 204.
